1. When saving a map, the map name must include both a building number and a floor number.

2. Building and floor numbers start from 1. Do not use 0.

3. The building number is written in the map name between the map prefix and the floor number, in this format:

 {mapPrefix}{buildingNumber}_{floorNumber}

 Example: office1_3
 means map prefix office, building 1, floor 3.

 Single-building maps must also include the building number, e.g. office1_2, not office_2.

Tip: Drag this box to reposition. Tap the close button to collapse to a dot.
No floor data found for map "%1$s"

[Add/Delete Floors]
1. Newly added floors default to "New Floor"; please rename with meaningful names immediately.
2. Deleting a floor will also remove its wait point, preride point, ride point, and transition point.
3. After adding/deleting, check that floor numbers are consecutive to avoid gaps (e.g., 1→3 missing floor 2).

[Building Tab Switching]
4. Save current changes before switching building tabs (tap the Save button in the dialog).
5. Newly created floors without coordinates may be lost when switching buildings.
6. Custom floor aliases may be reset to default names after switching.

[Upload/Download Points]
7. Upload and download sync all point data (including elevator points).
8. Downloading may overwrite locally customized floor aliases and numbers.
9. Confirm that elevator configurations are saved before uploading/downloading.
10. After downloading, check that the elevator floor list is complete and numbers are correct.

[Delete Elevator]
11. Deleting an elevator will remove all its floors and points.
12. Other elevators on the same floor are not affected.
13. This action is irreversible; please verify carefully in the confirmation dialog.
